authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9758.1 matsya gives Prakrit maccha, Bihari/Hindi machlī/macharī and Bshk. mac “fish”; branch 2 *matsiya separately includes Khowar and Kalasha macī. These are kept distinct from the fly family despite similar modern forms. Joint survey comparison leaves inheritance versus transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open. Comparative check: Bshk mas “fish” (f_x3viryggpowhs). The exact survey spelling and phonetic marks remain untouched. Stress, vowel articulation, release marks and source palatal/sibilant notation were reviewed as local details; the full form and sense support the same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.
